title: Community Care Volunteer Drive
description: Join local volunteers supporting families with essential resources and guidance.
full_description: Spend a meaningful day with CareBridge Foundation as volunteers sort community donations, prepare support kits and help families connect with trusted welfare resources.

organization.description: CareBridge Foundation improves access to essential community support through local volunteer programs.

title: Women Entrepreneurs Peer Circle
description: Meet mentors and peers for an afternoon of practical business support.
full_description: Shakti Collective brings together women-led businesses for guided conversations on finance, marketing and sustainable growth, followed by one-to-one mentor introductions.

organization.description: Shakti Collective enables women entrepreneurs through mentorship, skills and community networks.

title: Neighborhood Health Screening Camp
description: Free blood pressure, blood sugar and wellness checks for residents.
full_description: CareBridge Foundation's medical team will provide basic health assessments, wellness guidance and referrals for follow-up care. Walk-ins are welcome while capacity lasts.

organization.description: CareBridge Foundation improves access to essential healthcare through community-led programs.

title: Senior Wellness Morning
description: Gentle movement, nutrition guidance and a social morning for seniors.
full_description: Golden Circle hosts a welcoming morning of low-impact exercise, nutrition information and social connection for senior citizens. Family members and caregivers are welcome.

organization.description: Golden Circle builds active, connected and supported communities for senior citizens.

title: Digital Skills Open Classroom
description: Learn practical digital tools in a friendly, beginner-focused workshop.
full_description: NextStep Learning Trust offers guided practice with email, online safety, document creation and essential workplace tools. Participants can ask questions and work at their own pace.

organization.description: NextStep Learning Trust provides accessible learning and employability programs for underserved communities.

title: After-School Reading Workshop
description: A creative reading and study session for children aged 8 to 14.
full_description: Little Horizons invites children to an engaging afternoon of reading practice, storytelling and guided study. Volunteers provide age-appropriate learning materials and support.

organization.description: Little Horizons creates supportive learning spaces for children through tutoring and enrichment activities.

title: Neighborhood Resource Fair
description: Meet local groups and discover resources, activities and volunteer opportunities.
full_description: Common Ground Delhi brings local organizations together for an open community resource fair. Residents can learn about support services, sign up to volunteer and enjoy activities for all ages.
location: Nehru Nagar Community Ground, New Delhi

organization.description: Common Ground Delhi helps residents navigate and access locally available community resources.

title: Green Streets Volunteer Day
description: Work with neighbors to improve shared spaces and build community connections.
full_description: Gatherly volunteers will plant, clean and refresh shared neighborhood spaces together. The day closes with a community picnic and a short local music program.

organization.description: Common Ground Bengaluru creates welcoming opportunities for neighbors to collaborate and care for shared spaces.
